newsitem.title: CANADA: Horsham Clark unit sells crude receivable.
newsitem.headline: Horsham Clark unit sells crude receivable.

text.p: Horsham Corp said on Friday its 46 percent owned unit Clark USA Inc sold one of its advance crude oil production receivables for net proceeds of about US$235 million.
The receivables were acquired in December 1995.

Horsham said as a result of the transaction, Clark will have nearly US$350 million of cash and will recognize about US$114 million of equity issued as part of the original consideration for the advance crude oil production receivable.
Horsham said Clark has generally maintained substantial cash reserves to mitigate the cyclical nature of its business.
These cash balances may also be used to enhance existing assets, to make acquisitions or cut debt levels.
Horsham said Clark will record a gain on this deal.
